head_commit.message:
Retry bootstrap GETs through the system proxy after request failures

## Why

Account discovery and cloud configuration GETs can fail after connecting but before receiving response headers. These request failures previously bypassed system proxy fallback.

## What changed

Allow bootstrap GETs to retry through the system proxy on request errors, alongside the existing connection failure and timeout cases, when fallback is enabled.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for connections closed before response headers on `accounts/check` and `config/bundle`, verifying successful proxy retries with the original request headers. Extend coverage to ensure HTTP responses with status `401`, `403`, `407`, `429`, or `503` do not trigger fallback, and network policy denials prevent requests to both the origin and proxy.

head_commit.message:
Fix marketplace path matching for Windows junctions (#52696)

## Why

Equivalent local source paths can fail to match an already-added marketplace, and redirected managed roots can lose their managed classification on Windows.

## What changed

- Compare local marketplace sources after filesystem normalization.
- Reuse the resolved request path when locating an existing local marketplace so retargeting a configured junction does not switch the returned root.
- Accept both the configured managed root and its canonical target on Windows while continuing to reject unowned aliases to that target.

## Testing

Add Windows regression tests for canonical and legacy path spellings, retargeted local-source junctions, and redirected managed roots with unowned aliases.
